claims.source_quote_ar: ثم أدخلت الفاء لإفادة معنى السببية
claims.claim_ar: الفاء في «فَإِلَيْنَا» تعمل كأداة ربط سببي/نتجي، تربط نتيجة ما قبلها بما بعدها (سبب/نتيجة).
claims.claim_en: The prefixed fa- in «فَإِلَيْنَا» functions as a causal/sequential connector, linking the preceding clause with the following result/return.

claims.claim_ar: حرف «ثُمَّ» يعمل كأداة ترتيب/تعقيب بين الجمل؛ يبيّن تتابع الأحوال/الأحداث (ثم بعدها بيان شاهد الله).
claims.claim_en: The particle «ثُمَّ» functions as a coordinating particle indicating sequence/continuation between clauses; it marks the succession of events (then comes the statement of God's witnessing).

claims.claim_ar: المقطع «نُرِيَنَّكَ ... أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ» يمثل مقابلة فعلية/موازنة: فعلان متقابلان كخيارين متعاكسين (إظهار جزء مما نعدهم أو قبضك)، مما يؤكد التباين والاحتمال بين خيارين.
claims.claim_en: The sequence «We may show you part of what We promise them or We cause you to die» forms a verbal parallelism/contrast: two verbs presented as alternative/opposed options, emphasizing the contrast and contingency between the two possibilities.
claims.needs_review_reason: Support is inferential: the cited source substring treats ثُمَّ as coordinating/sequence; it shows similar verb-sequence usage but does not explicitly label this exact ayah as 'مقابلة' — needs specialist verification against classical rhetorical commentary.

warnings: Source chunks provided are mainly grammatical/commentarial (Darwish i'rab, Zamakhshari) and do not include explicit excerpts from the originally requested balagha authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir-balagha). Some rhetorical attributions are therefore inferred from grammatical commentary rather than direct classical balagha statements.

One claim (mukabalah / verbal parallelism) is based on structural inference and uses a general grammatical citation about sequence; it should be reviewed against specialized rhetorical commentaries for confirmation.
